Title: trim (
Description:
trim returns a copy of subsequence of string str
    with all the characters present in trimchars trimmed off from the beginning.
    If the second argument is omitted, it is a space ' ' by default.
trim
rtrim is similar except that it trims from
    the right.
rtrim
trim trims from both ends.
concat('*',trim('   SIMURG   '),'*') -> '*SIMURG*'
ltrim('AbracadabrA','bAr')  -> 'acadabrA'
rtrim('AbracadabrA','bAr')  -> 'Abracada'
trim('AbracadabrA','bAr')    -> 'acada'
